info.title: AegisOps API
info.description: Enterprise AI incident response control plane (local, production-style).

post.description:
Alertmanager webhook (bearer = AEGIS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN). Each accepted alert is persisted
before the response; duplicates (same fingerprint + startsAt) are acknowledged, not re-created.

post.description: Approver role only. `plan_hash` must equal the stored plan hash (what the human reviewed).

post.description: Cancels pending work; a running execution stops before its next step.
Manual resolution of a needs_attention incident (recorded with the human's note).

get.description: Reads evaluation/results/*/summary.json produced by the evaluation harness.

schema.title: Response List Evaluations Api V1 Evaluations Get

get.description:
Server-Sent Events. `id:` = TimelineEvent.event_id, `event:` = TimelineEvent.kind,
`data:` = TimelineEvent JSON. Reconnects resume after Last-Event-ID without losing entries.
Without incident_id the stream carries all incidents' events. Sends a `ping` comment every 15s.

ActionType.title: ActionType
ActionType.description: Every mutation AegisOps can ever perform. Anything else is impossible by construction.

AlertRef.title: AlertRef
AlertRef.description: An alert (or manual report / health check) attached to an incident.

FaultType.title: FaultType
FaultType.description: Diagnosis categories. Agents choose one; evaluation compares against the hidden expected value.

IncidentMetrics.title: IncidentMetrics
IncidentMetrics.description: Timing and cost facts used by the dashboard and evaluation (all optional until reached).

MemoryRecord.title: MemoryRecord
MemoryRecord.description: Long-term, validated, reusable knowledge. Written only from verified outcomes.

Prerequisite.title: Prerequisite
Prerequisite.description: A fact about the current environment that must still hold when a step executes.

RemediationPlan.title: RemediationPlan
RemediationPlan.description:
An immutable plan revision. Any content change requires a new plan_id/revision, a new
review, and a new human approval. `plan_hash` binds approvals to this exact content.

RunMode.title: RunMode
RunMode.description: How agent reasoning is produced. Always shown in the UI and recorded with every result.

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: Dashboard-facing event. `event_id` is a ULID-based durable id used as the SSE event id.

VerificationSignal.title: VerificationSignal
VerificationSignal.description: Named, bounded recovery signals. Targets are service, deployment, or queue names.
